lines.label: B1
lines.reason: This is the only formed fold, at about 81.5 deg (included angle 98.5 deg), between the large flange with two holes (patch 1 outer skin) and the narrow flange with the window (patch 4). I took perpendicular sections at 2/25/50/75/98% of the line. Each one puts the line on the convex outer-skin apex, with the nearest scan point 0.11-0.19 mm away. The inner skin sits about 1.97 mm inside it. The line is parallel to the fold over its full run. It is 70.2 mm long and the part spans 71.5 mm along the bend direction, so it covers about 98% of the fold. The window lies inside the narrow flange and does not interrupt the fold.
